per_object_cap.notes: SwissTransfer accepts files up to 50 GB in size.

retention.stated: Retention: 15 days by default; 30 only if the SENDER accepts an extension email on day 12 (offer open 3 days)
retention.notes: When choosing 30 days, files are automatically deleted after 15 days; the extension is offered to the sender by email on the 12th day and remains available for 3 days.

egress.terms: If the archive exceeds 10 GB, you will need to download the data files one by one.

tooling: Swissfer (github.com/Blutsh/swissfer, 44 stars, pushed 2026-10-21). Rust CLI, upload AND download, email-confirmed sender. First upload requires a 6-character code emailed to you, then cached. Upstream `send`-style clients do not work.
chaining: A send is free, needs no account and transfers up to 50 Go.
limits_note: Per-object-cap: 50 GB per transfer (combined, not per file). Retention: 15 days by default; 30 only if the SENDER accepts an extension email on day 12 (offer open 3 days). After expiry Infomaniak states a link cannot be reactivated or extended. pull-count: download cap selectable at 1/20/100/250. 'unlimited' requires a paid plan. Request-rate: the container-create endpoint enforces a reCAPTCHA field (see reliability note).
reliability_note: The write path requires human verification at the API: POST /api/containers without a recaptcha field returns 400 'The recaptcha field is required. (and 1 more error)'. swissfer routes around this with an emailed 6-char confirmation, not with a token. The 30-day option is a trap. It silently deletes at 15 days unless the sender acts on day 12.
